verdict.rationale: PayPal supports bulk-style operations in specific areas—Payouts to thousands of recipients at once (paypal-docs-24, paypal-docs-5) and programmatic Disputes/Invoicing APIs (paypal-docs-7, paypal-docs-26, paypal-docs-4)—but there is no evidence of a general-purpose bulk operation capability across arbitrary item types (e.g., bulk invoice creation, bulk order/transaction updates, bulk refunds) or AI-native batch tooling in the MCP/agent toolkit. missing for 10: bulk invoicing/orders/refunds endpoints, evidence of batch operations exposed via the MCP server or agent toolkit, and any independent confirmation of bulk operation reliability at scale.
